_comment: NIR absorption of pure fat (mammalian). Van Veen/OMLC 429-1098 nm; peuchant block = literature-based estimate so pure fat gives high TC.
citation: R.L.P. van Veen et al., Determination of VIS-NIR absorption coefficients of mammalian fat, OSA BIOMED 2004
_peuchant_notes: Estimated mu_a for lipid at Peuchant wavelengths (CH2 bands 1720-1760 nm strong; 1680 nm CH; 1445/1940 OH; 2190/2208 combination). Refs: Bashkatov et al. Opt. Spectrosc. 99 (2005) adipose 400-2500 nm; Peuchant 1987 cholesterol peaks 1718, 1750 nm.
notes: Pure fat at 1722/1734 nm has strong CH2 absorption -> low R -> high TC. Constant extrapolation from 1098 nm underestimated TC.
